# Bestand om file te downloaden

## Download link
```{r}
if (!file.exists("data/raw/video_view.csv")) {
data_url <- paste0(
"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hannesdatta/",
"course-dprep/refs/heads/main/material/tutorials/r-bootcamp-rev/",
"video_view.csv"
)
download.file(data_url, "data/raw/video_view.csv")
}
```
